rule: Each absolute local file-system path under the home directory of the machine that wrote the file is replaced in place by "<local-input>/" followed by the last component of that path. In paper_capacity_independent.py, the name of the environment variable that the session runtime sets is replaced by AGENT_THREAD_ID. No other byte changes, and line numbers are unchanged.
verification: paper_nested_decision.frozen_sha(), used by paper_nested_decision.py and paper_nested_decision_check.py, and paper_capacity_score_audit.py accept a listed file only when its SHA-256 equals redacted_sha256; they then use original_sha256, the hash that the freeze, manifest and score records cite. Files not listed here must match those records directly.
